files.patch:
@@ -3,3 +3,3 @@
 WhatsApp AI banker. API Gateway -> `webhook` Lambda -> SQS `inbound` -> `worker` Lambda

code_changes.title: feat: greet first-time users by name
code_changes.author: meera

files.patch:
@@ -3,3 +3,4 @@
 Only quote numbers (balances, prices, quantities, order states) that appear in TOOL RESULTS.
 If a tool result is an error, say you could not fetch that information right now and offer to try again.
